description: React functional component 'UserAgentActivity' that handles data fetching, state management, and rendering of user agent activity dashboards, including charts and summary cards. It integrates API calls for DAU, WAU, MAU, and user agent summaries, and utilizes libraries such as '@tremor/react' and 'antd'.

methods.name: extractUserAgent
methods.description: Helper to extract the user agent string from a tag.

methods.name: truncateUserAgent
methods.description: Shortens user agent string for display with tooltip.

methods.name: getAllTagsForData
methods.description: Aggregates tags from data for chart categories.

methods.description: Prepares data for daily active users chart.

methods.description: Prepares data for weekly active users chart.
